_comment: One source of truth for what is NOT part of a project (F30). Read by src/projectScope.ts and every scripts/analyze_* walk. alwaysSkip: never analyzed (vendored deps, compiled output, committed bundles). artefact: build output; the extension keeps git-tracked files inside them (hand-written build scripts), a standalone analyzer walk skips them entirely. Directories starting with '.' are always skipped.
